name: [CernoIA PROD] WF-018 - Faltantes vigencias y plan de acción

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.sync_cursors
(
    source_code,
    status,

    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    error_message,

    metadata,

    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    $1::TEXT,

    'idle',

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-018',

        'source_code',
        $1::TEXT,

        'initialized_by',
        'WF-018',

        'initialized_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    source_code
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.sync_cursors.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-018',

            'last_initialized_at',
            NOW(),

            'last_initialized_by',
            'WF-018'
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    source_code,
    status,

    active_execution_id,

    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    error_message,

    metadata,

    updated_at;

WITH stale_cursor AS
(
    SELECT
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.active_execution_id

    FROM ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND
      (
          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              < NOW()

          OR

          cursor.lock_acquired_at
              <
              NOW()
              -
              (
                  $2::INTEGER
                  * INTERVAL '1 minute'
              )
      )

    LIMIT 1
),

closed_run AS
(
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'failed',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            'stale_lock_recovery',

        error_message =
            'WF-018 recuperó un bloqueo vencido.',

        error_details =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_details,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'recovery_type',
                'stale_lock',

                'recovered_by',
                'WF-018',

                'recovered_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-018'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          stale.active_execution_id::TEXT

      AND run.status =
          'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id
),

recovered_cursor AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'error',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            'Stale lock recovered by WF-018',

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'stale_lock_recovered',
                TRUE,

                'stale_lock_recovered_at',
                NOW(),

                'stale_lock_recovered_by',
                'WF-018'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM stale_cursor
        AS stale

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          stale.source_code

      AND cursor.active_execution_id =
          stale.active_execution_id

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM stale_cursor
    )
        AS stale_lock_found,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM closed_run
    )
        AS workflow_run_closed,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM recovered_cursor
    )
        AS lock_recovered,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT;

WITH lock_attempt AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            $2::TEXT,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW()
            +
            (
                $3::INTEGER
                * INTERVAL '1 minute'
            ),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-018',

                'active_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'active_execution_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'plan_version',
                1,

                'generation_method',
                'deterministic_v1'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND
      (
          cursor.active_execution_id
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at
              < NOW()

          OR

          cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
              $2::TEXT
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,

        cursor.status,

        cursor.active_execution_id,

        cursor.lock_acquired_at,

        cursor.lock_expires_at,

        cursor.error_message,

        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_acquired,

    acquired.source_code,

    acquired.status
        AS cursor_status,

    acquired.active_execution_id,

    acquired.lock_acquired_at,

    acquired.lock_expires_at,

    acquired.error_message,

    acquired.updated_at

FROM lock_attempt
    AS acquired


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_acquired,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lock_attempt
  )

LIMIT 1;

    },
  },
];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs
(
    workflow_code,

    source_code,

    n8n_execution_id,

    trigger_type,

    status,

    started_at,

    error_details,

    metadata,

    created_at,

    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    'WF-018',

    'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_ACTION_PLAN_GENERATION',

    $1::TEXT,

    $2::TEXT,

    'running',

    NOW(),

    '{}'::JSONB,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-018',

        'source_code',
        'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_ACTION_PLAN_GENERATION',

        'plan_version',
        1,

        'generation_method',
        'deterministic_v1',

        'started_by',
        'WF-018',

        'started_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),

    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    n8n_execution_id
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    workflow_code =
        'WF-018',

    source_code =
        'SECOP_OPPORTUNITY_ACTION_PLAN_GENERATION',

    trigger_type =
        EXCLUDED.trigger_type,

    status =
        'running',

    started_at =
        NOW(),

    finished_at =
        NULL,

    completion_reason =
        NULL,

    error_node =
        NULL,

    error_message =
        NULL,

    error_details =
        '{}'::JSONB,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id
        AS workflow_run_id,

    workflow_code,

    source_code,

    n8n_execution_id,

    status
        AS workflow_run_status,

    started_at,

    updated_at;

WITH current_evaluations AS
(
    SELECT
        evaluation.id
            AS evaluation_id,

        evaluation.organization_id,

        evaluation.opportunity_analysis_id,

        evaluation.matrix_id,

        evaluation.process_reference,

        evaluation.overall_status,

        evaluation.compliance_score,

        evaluation.evaluation_version,

        evaluation.evaluation_method,

        evaluation.updated_at,

        ENCODE(
            DIGEST(
                CONVERT_TO(
                    CONCAT_WS(
                        '|',

                        evaluation.id::TEXT,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.updated_at::TEXT,
                            ''
                        ),

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.overall_status,
                            ''
                        ),

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.compliance_score::TEXT,
                            ''
                        ),

                        COALESCE(
                            (
                                SELECT
                                    STRING_AGG(
                                        TO_JSONB(item)::TEXT,
                                        '|'
                                        ORDER BY
                                            item.id
                                    )

                                FROM
                                    saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluation_items
                                        AS item

                                WHERE item.evaluation_id =
                                      evaluation.id
                            ),

                            ''
                        )
                    ),

                    'UTF8'
                ),

                'sha256'
            ),

            'hex'
        )
            AS current_input_hash

    FROM
        saas.opportunity_compliance_evaluations
            AS evaluation

    WHERE evaluation.is_current =
          TRUE

      AND evaluation.evaluation_status =
          'completed'
),

current_plans AS
(
    SELECT
        plan.id
            AS current_plan_id,

        plan.organization_id,

        plan.opportunity_analysis_id,

        plan.evaluation_id
            AS planned_evaluation_id,

        plan.input_hash_sha256::TEXT
            AS stored_input_hash,

        plan.generation_status,

        plan.plan_version,

        plan.generation_method,

        plan.updated_at
            AS plan_updated_at

    FROM
        saas.opportunity_action_plans
            AS plan

    WHERE plan.is_current =
          TRUE
),

candidates AS
(
    SELECT
        evaluation.*,

        plan.current_plan_id,

        plan.planned_evaluation_id,

        plan.stored_input_hash,

        plan.generation_status
            AS current_generation_status,

        plan.plan_version
            AS current_plan_version,

        plan.generation_method
            AS current_generation_method,

        plan.plan_updated_at,

        CASE

            WHEN plan.current_plan_id
                 IS NULL
                THEN
                    'NO_PLAN'

            WHEN plan.generation_status
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 'completed'
                THEN
                    'PLAN_NOT_COMPLETED'

            WHEN plan.planned_evaluation_id
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 evaluation.evaluation_id
                THEN
                    'EVALUATION_CHANGED'

            WHEN plan.generation_method
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 'deterministic_v1'
                THEN
                    'METHOD_CHANGED'

            WHEN plan.stored_input_hash
                 IS DISTINCT FROM
                 evaluation.current_input_hash
                THEN
                    'INPUT_CHANGED'

            ELSE
                NULL

        END
            AS claim_reason

    FROM current_evaluations
        AS evaluation

    LEFT JOIN current_plans
        AS plan

        ON plan.organization_id =
           evaluation.organization_id

       AND plan.opportunity_analysis_id =
           evaluation.opportunity_analysis_id
),

claimed AS
(
    SELECT
        *

    FROM candidates

    WHERE claim_reason
          IS NOT NULL

    ORDER BY
        updated_at ASC,
        evaluation_id

    LIMIT $1::INTEGER
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS has_evaluation,

    claim_reason,

    evaluation_id,

    organization_id,

    opportunity_analysis_id,

    matrix_id,

    process_reference,

    overall_status,

    compliance_score,

    evaluation_version,

    evaluation_method,

    current_input_hash,

    current_plan_id,

    planned_evaluation_id,

    stored_input_hash,

    current_generation_status,

    current_plan_version,

    current_generation_method,

    updated_at
        AS evaluation_updated_at,

    plan_updated_at

FROM claimed


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS has_evaluation,

    'NO_EVALUATIONS'::TEXT
        AS claim_reason,

    NULL::UUID
        AS evaluation_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS opportunity_analysis_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS matrix_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS overall_status,

    NULL::NUMERIC
        AS compliance_score,

    NULL::INTEGER
        AS evaluation_version,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS evaluation_method,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS current_input_hash,

    NULL::UUID
        AS current_plan_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS planned_evaluation_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS stored_input_hash,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS current_generation_status,

    NULL::INTEGER
        AS current_plan_version,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS current_generation_method,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
        AS evaluation_updated_at,

    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ
        AS plan_updated_at

WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM claimed
);

nodes.name: Procesar evaluaciones una a una WF-018

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS
(
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $1::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS raw_evaluation_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $2::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS n8n_execution_id
),

validated AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN raw_evaluation_id
                 ~*
                 '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'

                THEN raw_evaluation_id::UUID

            ELSE NULL::UUID
        END
            AS evaluation_id,

        n8n_execution_id

    FROM parameters
),

generated AS
(
    SELECT
        result.*

    FROM validated
        AS parameters

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        saas.generate_opportunity_action_plan_v1
        (
            parameters.evaluation_id,
            parameters.n8n_execution_id
        )
        AS result

    WHERE parameters.evaluation_id
          IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS has_plan,

    generated.*

FROM generated


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS has_plan,

    NULL::UUID
        AS action_plan_id,

    parameters.evaluation_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS process_reference,

    'invalid_evaluation_id'::TEXT
        AS result_code,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS plan_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS priority_level,

    NULL::NUMERIC
        AS compliance_score,

    0::INTEGER
        AS total_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS open_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS blocker_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS critical_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS high_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS medium_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS low_action_count,

    0::INTEGER
        AS manual_review_action_count,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS input_hash_sha256,

    0::INTEGER
        AS plan_version,

    FALSE
        AS changes_applied

FROM validated
    AS parameters

WHERE parameters.evaluation_id
      IS NULL;

WITH parameters AS
(
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $1::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS action_plan_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $2::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS execution_id
),

updated_plan AS
(
    UPDATE saas.opportunity_action_plans
        AS plan

    SET
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                plan.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'production_workflow',
                'WF-018',

                'production_execution_id',
                parameters.execution_id,

                'production_processed_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        n8n_execution_id =
            parameters.execution_id,

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM parameters

    WHERE plan.id =
          parameters.action_plan_id

    RETURNING
        plan.id,
        plan.evaluation_id,
        plan.process_reference,
        plan.plan_version,
        plan.plan_status,
        plan.priority_level,
        plan.compliance_score,
        plan.total_action_count,
        plan.open_action_count,
        plan.blocker_action_count,
        plan.generation_status,
        plan.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS plan_processed,

    'PLAN_RESULT_REGISTERED'
        AS registration_status,

    updated.*

FROM updated_plan
    AS updated;

WITH metrics AS
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS processed_plans,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE plan.plan_status =
                  'blocked'
        )::INTEGER
            AS blocked_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE plan.plan_status =
                  'manual_review'
        )::INTEGER
            AS manual_review_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE plan.plan_status =
                  'needs_action'
        )::INTEGER
            AS needs_action_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE plan.plan_status =
                  'completed'
        )::INTEGER
            AS completed_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                plan.total_action_count
            ),
            0
        )::INTEGER
            AS generated_action_count,

        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                plan.blocker_action_count
            ),
            0
        )::INTEGER
            AS blocker_action_count

    FROM saas.opportunity_action_plans
        AS plan

    WHERE plan.metadata
              ->> 'production_execution_id'
          =
          $1::TEXT
),

finalized AS
(
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            CASE
                WHEN metrics.processed_plans = 0
                    THEN 'no_evaluations'

                ELSE 'completed'
            END,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        error_details =
            COALESCE(
                run.error_details,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'workflow_code',
                'WF-018',

                'processed_plans',
                metrics.processed_plans,

                'blocked_count',
                metrics.blocked_count,

                'manual_review_count',
                metrics.manual_review_count,

                'needs_action_count',
                metrics.needs_action_count,

                'completed_count',
                metrics.completed_count,

                'generated_action_count',
                metrics.generated_action_count,

                'blocker_action_count',
                metrics.blocker_action_count,

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM metrics

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-018'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT

      AND run.status =
          'running'

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.status,
        run.completion_reason,
        run.finished_at
)

SELECT
    metrics.processed_plans,

    metrics.blocked_count,

    metrics.manual_review_count,

    metrics.needs_action_count,

    metrics.completed_count,

    metrics.generated_action_count,

    metrics.blocker_action_count,

    CASE
        WHEN metrics.processed_plans = 0
            THEN 'no_evaluations'

        ELSE 'completed'
    END
        AS completion_reason,

    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM finalized
    )
        AS execution_finalized,

    NOW()
        AS finished_at

FROM metrics;

WITH released AS
(
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-018',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'plan_version',
                1,

                'generation_method',
                'deterministic_v1'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $2::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,

    released.status
        AS cursor_status,

    released.active_execution_id,

    released.lock_acquired_at,

    released.lock_expires_at,

    released.error_message,

    released.updated_at

FROM released


UNION ALL


SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,

    cursor.lock_acquired_at,

    cursor.lock_expires_at,

    cursor.error_message,

    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM released
  )

LIMIT 1;
